ns2:course.label: Production Practicum II
ns2:course.description: Practical experience in the production of dance concerts mounted in the Krannert Center for the Performing Arts. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours but no more than 2 hours in any one term. (1 hour credit per concert up to 2 hours per term.) Prerequisite: Restricted to Dance majors and minors only.
